page.overview:
Who is Gennai?

Gennai was already doubtful that he could pass the Chūnin Exams and become a chūnin but after he saw his teammate Komugi quit the Exams, Gennai became even more doubtful and quit as well. He, like his teammates, is overconfident in his abilities.

Gennai has a short crop of dark brown hair and dark eyes. He wore a high-collared brown suit with matching pants and a beige sash. He also has a blue-clothed Konohagakure forehead protector which he wore in a traditional method.

In the anime, Gennai was shown to be able to use Fire Release, although he appears to need more time to use it as he was countered before he could perform a technique. He also has some taijutsu skills as he fought hand-to-hand against the Sunagakure ninja the night before the exam, but was knocked out by a blow to the neck from a more powerful opponent. Like the members of his team, Gennai is quite tough and fast, being one of the thirty people who managed to reach Sunagakure from Konohagakure in three days.

He and the rest of his teammates entered the Chūnin Exams. When Komugi chose not to complete the first phase afraid that they would never get the opportunity to retake the test again as Ibiki Morino told them, the rest of his team was disqualified as well.
